IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: THE SAN DIEGO MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION (SDMEA) IS DEDICATED TO BEING A STRONG AND EFFECTIVE ADVOCATE FOR SAN DIEGO CITY EMPLOYEES. SDMEA IS UNITED TO IMPROVE EMPLOYEES' STANDARD OF LIVING AND PROMOTE THEIR FAIR TREATMENT BY ENDEAVORING TO FULFILL SDMEA'S GUIDING EFFECTIVE ADVOCATE FOR SAN DIEGO CITY EMPLOYEES. MEA IS UNITED TO IMPROVE EMPLOYEES' STANDARD OF LIVING AND PROMOTE THEIR FAIR TREATMENT BY ENDEAVORING TO FULFULL MEA'S GUIDING PRINCIPLES. MEA VALUES DIVERSITY OF PEOPLE AND OPINION, RESPECT FOR ONE ANOTHER AND ITS INDEPENDENCE AS A UNION.

IRS990.Desc: THE ORGANIZATION PROVIDES MEMBERS WITH VARIOUS REPRESENTATIVE NEGOTIATIONS FOR PAY AND BENEFIT PROGRAMS WITH THE CITY OF SAN DIEGO.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: CONTRIBUTION TO SECTION 527 POLITICAL ORGANIZATION FOR CITY COUNCIL RACES IN SAN DIEGO, CA. NO VOLUNTEER TIME.

THE ASSOCIATION IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) SECTION 501(C)(5) AND THE CORRESPONDING PROVISIONS OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. THE PAC IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL AND STATE INCOME TAXES AS A 527 FUND. THE ASSOCIATION IS SUBJECT TO FEDERAL AND CALIFORNIA INCOME TAXES ON UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME, AS STIPULATED IN IRC SECTION 511. FOR THE YEARS ENDED JUNE 30, 2024 AND 2023, TAXES ARE RECORDED WHEN PAID AND NO PROVISION FOR INCOME TAX HAS BEEN MADE. THE ASSOCIATION AND PAC HAVE NO UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS OR LIABILITIES AS OF JUNE 30, 2024 AND 2023. THE ASSOCIATION AND PAC FILE EXEMPT RETURNS IN THE UNITED STATES FEDERAL JURISDICTION AND WITH THE FRANCHISE TAX BOARD IN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION HAS FOUR MEMBERSHIP LEVELS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION HAS FOUR MEMBERSHIP LEVELS, REGULAR, RETIREE, ASSOCIATE, AND HONORARY. REGULAR MEMBERS PAY DUES AND HAVE VOTING RIGHTS. OTHER MEMBERS ASSOCIATE, RETIREE, AND HONORARY DO NOT HAVE VOTING RIGHTS. REGULAR MEMBERS EACH HAVE ONE VOTING RIGHT AND VOTE FOR ALL BOARD MEMBERS AND OFFICERS NOMINATED BY THE NOMINATION COMMITTEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: DECISIONS OF THE GOVERNING BODY ARE SUBJECT TO APPROVAL BY VOTING MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE RETURN IS REVIEWED BY THE GENERAL MANAGER, OFFICERS, AND EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE MEMBERS PRIOR TO FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH DIRECTOR, OFFICER AND MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEE WITH DELEGATED POWERS WHO CAN INFLUENCE THE ACTIONS OF SDMEA SHALL ANNUALLY SIGN A STATEMENT WHICH AFFIRMS SUCH PERSON: - HAS RECEIVED A COPY OF THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY. - HAS READ AND UNDERSTANDS THE POLICY. - HAS AGREED TO COMPLY WITH THE POLICY. IN CONNECTION WITH ANY ACTUAL OR POSSIBLE CONFLICT OF INTEREST, AN INTERESTED PERSON MUST DISCLOSE THE EXISTENCE OF THE FINANCIAL INTEREST AND BE GIVEN THE OPPORTUNITY TO DISCLOSE ALL MATERIAL FACTS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS CONSIDERING THE PROPOSED TRANSACTION OR ARRANGEMENT. TRANSACTIONS WITH PARTIES WITH WHOM A CONFLICTING INTEREST EXISTS MAY BE UNDERTAKEN ONLY IF ALL OF THE FOLLOWING ARE OBSERVED: 1. THE CONFLICTING INTEREST IS FULLY DISCLOSED; 2. THE PERSON WITH THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST IS EXCLUDED FROM THE DISCUSSION AND APPROVAL OF SUCH TRANSACTION; 3. A COMPETITIVE BID OR COMPARABLE VALUATION EXISTS; AND 4. THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS HAS DETERMINED THAT THE TRANSACTION IS IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE ORGANIZATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SDMEA'S OFFICERS RESEARCH APPROPRIATE COMPENSATION LEVELS, BASED ON COMPARABLE POSITIONS IN COMPARABLE ORGANIZATIONS, AND MAKE AN OFFER. OVERALL STAFF BUDGET IS APPROVED ON AN ANNUAL BASIS BY THE ORGANIZATION'S BOARD. COMPENSATION APPROVAL FOR THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR INCLUDES REVIEW BY A COMPENSATION COMMITTEE, AND COMPARATIVE DATA. THE PROCESS IS DOCUMENTED. THE ORGANIZATION HAS NO OTHER PAID OFFICERS OR KEY EMPLOYEES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS ORIGINAL ORGANIZATIONAL DOCUMENTS AVAILABLE THROUGH REQUESTS OF PUBLIC DOCUMENT FORM 1024.
